Sunnyside Backyard

Labraduck

Labrador + Duck

Option A

A bright quack with the body of a single bark.

Option B

A low, rumbling guard call with a duck accent.

Option C

Two quick notes with an answering woof in the second.

Bunblebee

Bumblebee + Rabbit

Option A

Wing swell. A single bumblebee fly-by with a rabbit oink emerging from the buzz.

Option B

Curious oinks. A pair of quick rabbit calls with a low wing hum underneath.

Option C

Double flutter. Two naturally different bumblebee passes, with a rabbit grunt folded into the second pulse.

Cockapoodle

Cockatoo + Poodle

Option A

Bright yap. A fast poodle bark with a sharp cockatoo note opening into its tail.

Option B

Questioning squawk. A longer cockatoo roll with a low poodle accent near the end.

Option C

Double alert. Two cockatoo pulses with the sharper poodle onset tucked into the second.

Clover Farm

Cluckitty

Chicken + Kitten

Curious mewl

A soft kitten-led call with a pulsing cluck inside its attack.

Purr-cluck

A quick, chicken-led call with a short kitten reply folded into its tail.

Question trill

A gentler, drawn-out kitten call with short hen notes that break up the middle.

Donkeyote

Donkey + Coyote

Option A

Rolling hee-yip. A forward donkey bray curls into a coyote howl.

Option B

Double warning. A sharp coyote bark leads into two clipped donkey pulses.

Option C

Low prairie call. A heavier bray holds under a smoother, airy howl.

Flamingoat

Flamingo + Goat

Option A

Breezy honk. A short flamingo opening with a clear goat note carrying the sound forward.

Option B

Stuttering bleat. A goat-led call with little flamingo pulses inside its held note.

Option C

Double honk. Two flamingo phrases separated by a compact goat answer.

Woolrus

Sheep + Walrus

Option A

Baa-rumble. A rounded sheep bleat that takes on a walrus rumble as it starts.

Option B

Short huff. A compact walrus grunt with a lighter sheep reply.

Option C

Rolling baa. A pair of walrus pulses shapes a sheep note into a bouncy call.

Puglet

Pig + Pug

Option A

Snort-bark. A round pig grunt turns into one dry, close pug bark.

Option B

Double snuffle. Two quick pug barks with a pig snuffle underneath each beat.

Option C

Squeaky grumble. A pig squeak dips into a low, gruff pug bark.

Alpanda

Alpaca + Panda

Option A

Rising hum. A round alpaca hum lifts into a clear panda bleat.

Option B

Curious pair. Two gently spaced notes with a warmer panda answer.

Option C

Soft hiccup. A bright alpaca chirrup falls into a lower panda moan.

Ripplewater Lake

Crocodoodle Doo

Crocodile + Rooster

Raspy dawn crow

A rising rooster crow with a Nile crocodile chirr threaded through its middle.

Sharp river chirr

A low juvenile crocodile chirr with a short rooster accent.

Two-note wake-up call

A brief blend opens the call, followed by a higher crow with a second crocodile chirr.

Goosemoose

Canada Goose + Moose

Bright antler honk

A clear Canada goose honk with a low moose note beneath it.

Deep marsh call

A moose-led grunt with the goose honk rising out of the middle.

Double honk

Two short calls, with a brighter first honk and a heavier answering one.

Hootopotamus

Owl + Hippopotamus

Round hoot

A rounded owl hoot with a short hippo grunt tucked into its attack.

Swamp bellow

A chesty hippo bellow with an owl tone swelling over it.

Two-step hoot

A short grunt-hoot followed by a fuller, higher hoot.

Hamsturtle

Hamster + Turtle

Shell chirp

A close tortoise puff with a single bright hamster chirp at its crest.

Two quick squeaks

A paired hamster chatter leads into a tight, airy tortoise finish.

Soft snuffle

A lower, round breath opens the call, with two light squeaks settling into the tail.

Acorn Woods

Koalameleon

Koala + Chameleon

Low leaf huff

A compact koala bellow softens into a close chameleon breath.

Sharp inhale

A quick chameleon intake leads into a short, brighter koala reply.

Two dry breaths

A low koala pulse connects two short chameleon breaths.

Porcupython

Porcupine + Python

Chirr and hiss

A short porcupine chirr opens into a narrow, rising python hiss.

Quill rasp

A lower hiss swells around a clipped chatter from the porcupine.

Double warning

Two dry porcupine pulses sit inside a longer, softer hiss.

Jungle Wilds

Tigebra

Tiger + Zebra

Option A

Low rattling growl. A tiger growl rolls into a short burst of zebra chatter.

Option B

Quick nasal snap. A bright zebra bark has a short tiger snarl underneath.

Option C

Rising rasp. A longer zebra bray rises into an open tiger roar.

Peacockybara

Peacock + Capybara

Bright fan call

A rising peacock call with a brief capybara squeak tucked into its middle.

Low answering call

The capybara leads, followed by a lowered peacock call that fades at the end.

Quick double call

Two short peacock notes frame a brighter capybara squeak.

Golden Dunes

Swobra

Swan + Cobra

Option A

Trumpet hiss. A rounded swan call opens into a soft cobra hiss.

Option B

Striking call. The cobra snaps first, with a darker swan note swelling behind it.

Option C

Fluttering double call. Two lighter swan pulses chatter through a quick hiss.

Vulturkey

Turkey Vulture + Wild Turkey

Rattle gobble

A dry vulture rasp follows one short wild turkey pulse.

Dry warning

A vulture-led hiss finishes with a low, soft turkey warble.

Two feather notes

Two short turkey notes bracket a lower vulture rasp.

Camoucan

Camel + Toucan

Sand bark

A bright toucan bark gains a short camel throat underneath.

Throaty croon

A rolling camel groan ends with the clipped snap of a toucan.

Double desert call

Two toucan pulses carry across a short, lighter camel groan.

The Burning Depths

Lemu

Ring-tailed lemur + Emu

Drum chirp

A compact emu boom rises underneath a sharp little lemur chirp.

Bright answering call

A high lemur call goes first, answered by one upward-tuned emu thump.

Double hollow boom

Two rounded emu pulses surround a lower, longer lemur call.

Cloudstone Caverns

Froggle

Frog + Eagle

Option A

High chirrup, an eagle note with a quick ribbit crackle underneath.

Option B

Purring croak with a hollow eagle accent that rises out of it.

Option C

Two bouncy notes, each a ribbit fused to a short eagle chirp.

Cloudtop Cliffs

Sugarwing

Sugar Glider + White-tailed Ptarmigan

Quick climbing call

A short sugar glider yip introduces a bright rising ptarmigan note.

Soft answering rasp

A lowered ptarmigan call and a sugar glider rasp overlap and fade together.

Double ridge chirp

Two ptarmigan pulses bracket a short, brighter sugar glider yip.
